metaTitle: Dessert Cups FAQ: Allergens, Notice, Pickup, Delivery
metaDescription: Which flavours have nuts? How much notice do you need? Straight answers on allergens, deposits, Hamilton pickup and Saturday GTA delivery.
h1: Dessert cups FAQ: good to know before you order
intro: Planning dessert for a crowd comes with questions. Here are straight answers about our hand-layered dessert cups: allergens, how much notice we need, deposits, pickup in Hamilton and Saturday delivery, keeping the cups cold, and how packs, sizes and flavours fit together.

sections.heading: Planning a table with allergies in mind
sections.body:
The allergen facts are in the questions on this page. This part is about the table itself.

A suggestion for styling, not a rule: the three nut flavours have distinct tops, so they're easy to group or sign if you want to. Ferrero Royale wears a hazelnut sphere on dark glossy ganache, Dubai Chocolate a green marbled pistachio swirl, and Kinder Bueno a striped chocolate bite. Giving them their own corner helps guests choose at a glance.

That's a styling cue, not an allergen check. It doesn't make the rest of the table nut-free: cross-contact with nuts is possible in every cup.

sections.heading: Didn't see your question?
sections.body:
Message us on Instagram at @dessertshot.ca, or add it to the notes when you [send your order request](/order). We confirm within the day.

For what goes into each cup, layer by layer, browse the [full menu](/menu). For every pack and price side by side, see [packages](/packages).

faqs.q: Are your dessert cups gluten-free and eggless?
faqs.a: {{dietaryClaim}} And eggless isn't dairy-free: every cup contains dairy. If you avoid gluten or egg for medical reasons, message us on Instagram (@dessertshot.ca) before you order and ask about the flavours you have in mind.

Three flavours contain tree nuts: [Kinder Bueno](/menu/kinder-bueno), [Ferrero Royale](/menu/ferrero-royale) (hazelnut) and [Dubai Chocolate](/menu/dubai-chocolate) (pistachio). Every cup is made in the same kitchen, so cross-contact with nuts is possible in any flavour.

faqs.q: Do all your dessert cups contain dairy?
faqs.a: Yes. Every flavour contains dairy, so there isn't a dairy-free option on the menu. Dairy and tree nuts are the allergens we flag on each flavour. If you need to check another ingredient, ask us before you order.

faqs.q: Someone at my event has a severe food allergy. Can I still order?
faqs.a: Message us before you order. Leaving the nut flavours out doesn't remove the cross-contact risk, and we'd rather talk it through with you than have you guess. You can reach us on Instagram at @dessertshot.ca.
The morning of your pickup or delivery. Each cup is hand-layered that morning.

faqs.q: How much notice do you need?
faqs.a: For a 24 or 48 pack, at least 48 hours, counted to 9 AM on your pickup or delivery day (the morning we make your cups). That's our standard minimum. A 96 needs at least 7 days' notice: by 9 AM on the same day the week before. For a Saturday delivery of a 24 or 48, we suggest sending by Wednesday; see [Saturday delivery](/dessert-cups-gta) and [Hamilton pickup](/dessert-cups-hamilton). Send your request through the [order form](/order) and we'll confirm within the day.

faqs.q: Can I order with less than 48 hours' notice?
faqs.a: For a 24 or 48, you can ask. Anything under 48 hours is an urgent request: it's subject to availability, a rush fee applies, and we can't guarantee it. Send the request with your date and we'll let you know whether we can make it happen. A 96 is different: it always needs at least 7 days, and shorter notice isn't offered for it.

faqs.q: Do you deliver, and how much does delivery cost?
faqs.a: Yes, on Saturdays, to Hamilton, Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga and Toronto. The fee depends on your location, so we quote it when we confirm your order, as part of your total; the estimate in the order form doesn't include it. Add your postal code and address to your request so we can work out the fee. If you'd like a particular delivery time, ask for it in your notes. Someone needs to be there to receive the cups. Prefer to collect? Pickup in Hamilton is free. More on [Saturday delivery and fees](/dessert-cups-gta).

Pickup in Hamilton is free and arranged with you. Once your order is confirmed, we share the pickup location with the person who placed it. You don't have to collect in person: a friend, a colleague or a courier can pick up for you. More on [ordering dessert cups in Hamilton](/dessert-cups-hamilton).

faqs.q: How are the cups packed? Do they have lids?
faqs.a: The cups come in boxes of 24, and they don't have lids. A 24 pack is one box, a 48 is two boxes and a 96 is four.

faqs.q: Do the cups need to stay in the fridge?
faqs.a: Yes. Keep them refrigerated until you serve them. Out of the fridge, they can sit for about 2 hours, so set them out close to dessert time.

faqs.q: How many flavours can I put in one pack?
faqs.a: Up to 4 in a 24 pack, 8 in a 48 and 16 in a 96. Each flavour needs at least 6 cups, in multiples of 6 (6, 12, 18…), so a 48 could be eight flavours of 6 or four flavours of 12. Want more flavours than that? Choose a bigger pack, or order more than one. [Compare the packs](/packages).

faqs.q: Can I order more than one pack?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as each pack meets the minimums on its own: 24 cups or more, and at least 6 cups per flavour. The order form takes one pack at a time, so mention the other packs in your notes, or send another request for each one. There's no maximum order size.

faqs.q: Can I mix Classic and Premium flavours in one pack?
faqs.a: Yes, freely. Classic: Mango Dream, Strawberry Fields and Blueberry Haze. Premium: Kinder Bueno, Ferrero Royale, Biscoff Bliss, Dubai Chocolate and Tiramisu (Tiramisu comes as a Dessert Cup only). A mixed pack is priced cup by cup: each cup at its own tier's rate for that pack size, with the total rounded to the nearest dollar. See priced sample boxes on [packages](/packages).

faqs.q: What's the difference between Mini Shots and Dessert Cups?
faqs.a: Mini Shots are 2 oz, a tasting size. Dessert Cups are 5 oz, a full serving. Prices for both sizes, in every pack, are on [packages](/packages). A suggestion, not a rule: Dessert Cups suit a table where the cup is the dessert; Mini Shots suit a spread where guests want to try a few flavours.

faqs.q: Can I ask for something custom?
faqs.a: Yes, as a separate kind of order. Our menu is eight flavours, two cup sizes and three pack sizes, and the 96 pack comes with a custom label option. For anything beyond that, skip the order form: [email us]({{mailto}}) at {{contactEmail}} with the details, and we'll send you a separate quote.

faqs.q: What happens after I send my request?
faqs.a: We confirm it within the day, by email, text or Instagram. Until then, it's a request rather than a confirmed order. When we confirm, we give you your total, with the delivery fee included if you chose delivery, and explain how to pay the deposit that confirms your order. If you're collecting in Hamilton, we share the pickup location. Then, the morning of your date, we make your cups fresh.

faqs.q: How do I pay? Is there a deposit?
faqs.a: Not on this site. Ordering works by request, and nothing is charged when you send it. A deposit is required to confirm your order, and we explain how to pay it when we confirm, along with your total.
